notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial rubric after rereading docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md. ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, Yamamoto schedule sources, and current Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded verified Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. Two missing Jazz at Lincoln Center programs clear RADAR admission. Marsalis: Jazz Is Dance is A+ because it puts the JLCO inside a genuine music-and-movement collaboration with new Claudia Schreier choreography and a restaging of Spaces with Lil Buck and Jared Grimes; three performances and its place within a season-long Marsalis retrospective leave enough access that S would overstate scarcity. Call and Response is A because the orchestra's members reinterpret Marsalis's own compositions as the finale to the JLCO season, which is a specific and useful lens on the ensemble, but three performances and the abundance of stronger one-off/reunion contexts elsewhere in the same final season make it a worthy RADAR date rather than something that requires active priority. The proposed distribution is A+ / A, consistent with the current broad-base hierarchy rather than the former S-heavy admission filter.

en.why_it_matters: This is one of the final-season Marsalis programs where the cross-disciplinary idea is actually musical, not decorative. His writing for dance has always depended on pulse, weight, repetition and physical phrasing; putting the JLCO next to new Claudia Schreier choreography and returning to Spaces with Lil Buck and Jared Grimes makes movement part of the argument. It is a strong way to hear Marsalis's large-ensemble language from outside the normal concert-hall frame.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the three Rose Theater performances if a New York trip overlaps late May. The dance component makes this more distinctive than another repertory night, while three performances and the breadth of the season allow it to sit alongside, rather than displace, a rarer one-off elsewhere in the corridor.

es.why_it_matters: Éste es uno de los programas de la última temporada de Marsalis donde el cruce disciplinario sí es musical y no decorativo. Su escritura para danza depende desde siempre de pulso, peso, repetición y fraseo físico; poner a la JLCO frente a una coreografía nueva de Claudia Schreier y volver a Spaces con Lil Buck y Jared Grimes hace que el movimiento forme parte del argumento. Es una muy buena forma de escuchar su lenguaje de gran ensamble fuera del marco habitual de concierto.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las tres funciones en Rose Theater si un viaje a Nueva York coincide con finales de mayo. La dimensión de danza la vuelve más distintiva que otra noche de repertorio, pero las tres funciones y la amplitud de la temporada permiten acomodarla sin desplazar un one-off todavía más raro en el corredor.

en.why_it_matters: The useful angle here is not another celebration of Marsalis as a famous bandleader; it is hearing the orchestra answer back. JALC is explicitly putting its own members' arranging and interpretive voices on Marsalis's compositions, which turns the season finale into a view of how a 35-year institution has absorbed, contested and extended the language of its founding artistic director.
en.trip_verdict: Keep this on the New York board if a June trip is already taking shape. The ensemble-level perspective is worth hearing, but three performances and several more distinctive final-season programs mean it should fit around stronger anchors rather than determine the trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante aquí no es otra celebración de Marsalis como bandleader famoso, sino escuchar a la orquesta responderle. JALC está poniendo explícitamente las voces de arreglo e interpretación de sus propios integrantes sobre las composiciones de Marsalis; eso convierte el cierre de temporada en una forma de escuchar cómo una institución de 35 años absorbió, discutió y extendió el lenguaje de su director artístico fundador.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero de Nueva York si ya se está armando un viaje para junio. La perspectiva desde la propia orquesta sí vale la pena, pero las tres funciones y otros programas más distintivos de la última temporada hacen que funcione mejor alrededor de anclas más fuertes que como razón única del viaje.
